test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Higher Secondary Level) Official Paper (Held On: 02 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Match the concepts in Column I with their corresponding properties in Column II:

 
 
 
 
 
 

 **Column I (Concept)**
 **Column II (Property)**
 
 

 A. Chord bisected by center
 1. Line is perpendicular to chord
 
 

 B. Equal chords
 2. Subtend equal angles at center
 
 

 C. Distance from center to chord
 3. Helps compare chord lengths
 
 

 D. Perpendicular from center
 4. Bisects the chord
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Identify **unique properties** of circle theorems to match quickly.

**Equal chords** always subtend **equal angles** at the center → **B-2**.

**Distance from center** is inversely proportional to **chord length** → **C-3**.

**Perpendicular** from center always **bisects** the chord → **D-1** (logic of perpendicularity) and **A-4** (logic of bisection).

Matching these pairs leads directly to the correct sequence.

**∴ The correct answer is A-4, B-2, C-3, D-1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5d779e9b8d8b16b2dfb0761a2f3e4100effc63d4e7f8bed46772bbe8a7a96779.png] 

**Given:** A circle with center **O** and chord **AB**.

**Theorems applied:**

⇒ **Theorem 1:** The perpendicular from the center to a chord bisects it. Thus, **D** matches with **1** and **A** matches with **4**.

⇒ **Theorem 2:** Chords of equal length subtend equal angles at the center. Thus, **B** matches with **2**.

⇒ **Theorem 3:** The distance **d** from the center determines the length of the chord (longer chords are closer to the center). Thus, **C** matches with **3**.

⇒ By combining these standard geometric properties, we get the sequence: **A-4, B-2, C-3, D-1**.

**∴ The correct answer is A-4, B-2, C-3, D-1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Longest Chord

The **diameter** is the longest chord of a circle and its distance from the center is **zero**.

Chords and Arcs

If two chords of a circle are equal, then their corresponding **arcs** are congruent and vice versa.

Equidistant Chords

Chords that are **equidistant** from the center of a circle are **equal** in length.

Angle in a Semicircle

The angle subtended by a **diameter** at any point on the circumference is always a **right angle (90°)**.
